MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The outlet extender fits my repeated purchases of power strips and charging cables because it helps power several devices with less crowding.",
    "The SanDisk card and portable SSD fit my ongoing need to store and back up camera files, especially since I already use memory cards and a card reader; I would check device compatibility before choosing the larger card.",
    "The Fire TV Stick offers a useful new function for my television by adding streaming, even though 4K would not benefit my recorded 720p TV."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The Blink bundle treats my photography interests as an interest in home surveillance, but taking photos and monitoring my home serve different needs.",
    "The internal gaming SSD requires a compatible computer and an upgrade project I do not currently have; portable storage is more useful for my files.",
    "The Echo devices, AirPods, and Tesla coil kit introduce voice control, personal audio, or soldering activities that do not address my current accessory needs."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "Owning a Fire tablet seems to have been taken as a reason to want more Alexa devices, although I choose devices for specific uses.",
    "My electronics purchases seem to have been treated as broad interest in gadgets, overlooking the different purposes of photography accessories, security cameras, and hobby kits."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "I repeatedly choose practical accessories that support equipment I already own, such as mounts, cables, memory-card cases, and power strips.",
    "Compatibility matters: memory-card capacity, computer connections, and television resolution determine whether an appealing product would actually help me.",
    "My camera accessories and card reader point toward a connected routine of taking photos, transferring files, and keeping backups."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations partly understood my storage and power needs but stretched my practical electronics purchases into interests in smart-home devices and unrelated gadgets."
}
